job: Keep a section's content on one line of 1,200px, a 720px reading column, or the full width.
purpose: The content box inside every section: centred, at most --fd-site-max wide, with gutters that grow with the container from --fd-gutter. data-width="narrow" is a reading column; "full" runs edge to edge with no gutter. It defines no columns: each section lays out its own.
useWhen: Inside every fd-site-section, around its head and its parts.

avoidWhen.when: A bounded column inside app content.

variants.useWhen: Reading: a list FAQ, a long text, a form.
Media or a table that runs edge to edge.

parts.role: The content box of a section.
